# Moonshine Voice

**Voice Interfaces for Everyone**

[Moonshine](https://moonshine.ai) Voice is an open source AI toolkit for developers building real-time voice agents and applications.

Full guides, models, and API reference are at **[moonshine-voice.readthedocs.io](https://moonshine-voice.readthedocs.io/)**.

- Everything runs on-device — fast, private, and with no account or API keys.
- Optimized for live streaming, with low latency by doing work while the user is still talking.
- Speech to text models trained from scratch, from [higher accuracy than Whisper Large V3](https://huggingface.co/spaces/hf-audio/open_asr_leaderboard) down to [tiny 1MB models](micro/README.md).
- One library across [Python, JavaScript/WASM, iOS, Android, macOS, Linux, Windows, and Raspberry Pi](https://moonshine-voice.readthedocs.io/en/latest/quickstart/).

## Quickstart

<!-- doc-test: parse-only -->
```bash
pip install moonshine-voice
moonshine-voice mic --language en
```

Every other platform is covered in the [Quickstart](https://moonshine-voice.readthedocs.io/en/latest/quickstart/), with runnable samples in [Examples](https://moonshine-voice.readthedocs.io/en/latest/examples/).

candidates.description: Vectorless, structure-first retrieval over large Markdown libraries for AI agents — a TypeScript take on PageIndex for Markdown (CLI + MCP + AI SDK)
candidates.readme_excerpt:
# MarkIndex

[![CI](https://github.com/jackjin1997/markindex/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/jackjin1997/markindex/actions/workflows/ci.yml) [![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/markindex)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/markindex)

**Vectorless, structure-first retrieval over large libraries of long Markdown documents — for agents.**

MarkIndex parses every Markdown file into a tree of its own sections, stores the trees, the original lines and a
mixed Chinese/English BM25 index in one SQLite file, and gives an agent five read-only tools to walk
"library → folder → document → section" and read the original text with line numbers. No embeddings, no vector
database, no chunking guesswork: the document's own structure is the index, and every piece of evidence can be
cited back as `[doc_path, L<start>-<end>]`.

![MarkIndex demo: index five long documents, show a Chinese law's outline, search in Chinese and English](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jackjin1997/markindex/main/docs/assets/demo.gif)

> Inspired by [VectifyAI/PageIndex](https://github.com/VectifyAI/PageIndex), MarkIndex is an independent,
> unofficial TypeScript implementation focused on Markdown. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by VectifyAI.

中文说明：[README.zh-CN.md](README.zh-CN.md)

## Why

- **Structure-first, not chunk-first.** Long professional documents (filings, guidelines, laws, manuals) are
  already organized by their authors. Navigating that outline keeps context intact and makes answers explainable
  and citable; arbitrary chunks + vector similarity cut sections apart.
- **Deterministic and LLM-free indexing.** Parsing (mdast, not regex), tree building and the token-cost tree
  optimization never call a model; the same input always produces the same tree. LLMs are optional and only used
  for node summaries, document descriptions and the built-in `retrieve()` loop.
- **Markdown done properly.** Setext headings, preface text before the first heading, documents without any
  heading, front matter, `#` inside code fences, skipped heading levels, BOM / CRLF — every source line belongs to
  exactly one node, and oversized sections are split at block boundaries into `chunk` nodes.
- **Keyword fallback that works for Chinese.** BM25 over `Intl.Segmenter` word segmentation (Chinese, English and
  mixed text, identifiers like `C++`, `ISO-27001`, `v2.1`), plus a trigram substring index as a second pass.
- **Budgeted tool responses.** Tools never throw; they return JSO

Mutating commands require confirmation. - **Bring any model API.** Native OpenAI-compatible and Anthropic adapters, plus presets for popular hosted and local providers. - **Bring any MCP server or Agent Skill.** MCP over stdio and Streamable HTTP; lazy `SKILL.md` loading from common directories. - **Stay light.** No Electron, Node, Python, Docker, database, background daemon, or UI framework. - **Own your state.** Plain JSON config and JSONL sessions. API keys come from environment variables and are never written to Shim's config. # agent-desktop Computer use for AI agents: read and operate desktop apps through the OS accessibility tree.

A CLI and C library for macOS, Windows and Linux. A snapshot returns JSON with a ref for every element an agent can act on. The agent acts on a ref and snapshots again to check, with no pixel matching; the loop stays in your agent. On macOS, CLI calls reuse a private command host for each snapshot namespace and binary build. It retains native accessibility objects so a removed row cannot silently resolve to a surviving row with the same identifier. The host exits after 15 idle minutes. `TMPDIR` must be owned by the current user with mode `0700`; the standard macOS per-user temporary directory satisfies this requirement. Headless calls still prohibit foreground activation and synthesized input. Snapshots, clipboard reads, screenshots, command output and debug artifacts can contain private desktop content. Keep them out of public logs and uploads. The optional [JEV helper](skills/jev-desktop/SKILL.md) sends screen descriptions to a configured model provider; it is separate from the native CLI. See [privacy and data handling](docs/faq.md#what-data-can-contain-private-information). ## Installation Install on macOS, Windows or Linux with npm: ```bash npm install -g agent-desktop agent-desktop version ``` Bun, Yarn and pnpm can install the same package. It includes native binaries and platform helpers for x64 and ARM64. # ThinkSmart View 语音终端系统镜像

中文 | [English](README.en.md)

把联想 **ThinkSmart View（型号 CD-18781Y）** 刷成一台本地语音助手：开机直接进语音界面，说「小麦小麦」唤醒，背后可以接 Claude、DeepSeek 等多种大模型。

镜像基于 [rickx/ubuntu-thinksmart](https://github.com/rickx/ubuntu-thinksmart)（Ubuntu 24.04 + postmarketOS 内核 6.19），去掉了 Plasma 桌面，预装：

- 语音客户端 [xiaozhi-thinksmart-client](https://github.com/justhalfbit/xiaozhi-thinksmart-client)：唤醒、对话界面、睡眠时段、亮度、在线更新；
- 小智网关 [xiaozhi-hub-server](https://github.com/justhalfbit/xiaozhi-hub-server)：本机语音识别，接各家大模型和语音合成，带网页管理后台；
- 设备修复：两颗麦克风、扬声器、屏幕熄屏和接近唤醒、WiFi 稳定性、GPU 白屏/卡死补丁等。

目前界面和唤醒词都是中文。

> ⚠️ 刷机会清掉原来的 Teams / Android 系统。第一次刷之前**一定先整盘备份 eMMC**（[A2](#a2-整盘备份原厂-emmc必做)），这是以后回到原厂的唯一办法。

本文就是完整的刷机教程，写成了人和 AI 助手都能照着一步步做的样子。

---

## 目录

- [给 AI 助手的说明（先读这一节）](#给-ai-助手的说明先读这一节)
- [0. 准备](#0-准备)
- [1. 进入 EDL 模式，判断走哪条路线](#1-进入-edl-模式判断走哪条路线)
- [路线 A：第一次刷（设备还是原厂系统）](#路线-a第一次刷设备还是原厂系统)
- [路线 B：已经刷过本镜像或上游 Ubuntu 镜像](#路线-b已经刷过本镜像或上游-ubuntu-镜像)
- [2. 首次开机和设置](#2-首次开机和设置)
- [3. 常见问题排查](#3-常见问题排查)
- [4. 备份和还原用户数据](#4-备份和还原用户数据)
- [5. 以后的更新](#5-以后的更新)
- [附录：分区和镜像结构](#附录分区和镜像结构)
- [致谢和声明](#致谢和声明)

---

## 给 AI 助手的说明（先读这一节）

如果你是被用户叫来帮忙刷机的 AI 助手（Agent），请先读完这一节，再从第 0 步开始。

### 目标

把本仓库 Release 里的镜像写进用户这台 ThinkSmart View 的 `system` 分区，让它开机进入语音助手界面，然后陪用户完成首次设置（WiFi、网关管理员密码、API Key、改默认密码）。

### 整体流程

```
第 0 步  准备：确认型号 → 装 edl → 下载并校验文件
第 1 步  进 EDL 模式 → edl printgpt → 按 system 分区大小选路线
  路线 A（原厂系统）：整盘备份 → 刷 lk2nd 到 boot → 刷 bootstrap 到 system → 开机
                      → SSH 进 bootstrap 改分区表 → 关机 → 再进 EDL → 刷本镜像到 system
  路线 B（刷过 Ubuntu）：（可选）备份用户数据 → 进 EDL → 刷本镜像到 system
第 2 步  首次开机：屏幕配 WiFi → 找 IP → 网关后台设密码、填 API Key → 改两个账号的密码 → 试语音
```

### 必须先停下来、得到用户明确同意才能做的操作

下面每一项都不可逆，或者会清掉数据。执行前把**要执行的完整命令**和**后果**告诉用户，等用户明确回答「同意 / 可以 / 执行」之类的话再做。一次同意只管这一步，下一步要重新问。

| 步骤 | 操作 | 后果 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| A2 | 整盘备份时，目标文件已经存在 | 覆盖旧备份，旧备份就没了。默认换个文件名，不要覆盖 |
| A3 | `edl w boot lk2nd.img` | 原厂 bootloader 链被换成 lk2nd，Android/Teams 从此起不来 |
| A4 | `edl w system bootstrap…img` | 原厂 `system` 分区被覆盖 |
| A6 | 在 bootstrap 里运行 `apply-ubuntu-gpt.sh` | 改写整张分区表，原厂的 vendor、cache、userdata 等分区被删掉 |
| A8 / B3 | `edl w system thinksmart-ubuntu-…img` | `system` 分区原有内容全部被覆盖（包括旧系统里的聊天记录、API Key、WiFi 配置） |
| — | 任何 `edl wf`（整盘写回） | 整个 eMMC 被覆盖。只有用户明确要求回原厂时才用 |

另外两种情况也要停下来问：

- 任何一步的输出和本文写的「期望输出」对不上；
- 同一条写入命令失败了一次。可以说明情况后建议重试一次，再失败就停下来，别反复重试。

### 需要用户本人动手的操作

AI 助手做不了这些，到这一步要明确告诉用户做什么，等用户说「好了」再继续：

- 插拔 USB 线和电源线、换线、换电脑上的 USB 口；
- 按键组合进 EDL 模式（拔电源线 → 插 USB 线 → 按住音量 + 和音量 − → 插电源线 → 3～5 秒后松开音量键，见 1.1）；
- 关机和开机：这台设备**没有电源键**，插上电源线就开
